report.requirement: The controller's identity and how to contact it about personal data
report.evidence: Spotify USA Inc. is the data controller of personal data processed under this Policy
report.reason: The policy clearly identifies the controller and provides contact information.

report.requirement: Contact details of the data protection officer (DPO)
report.condition: The controller has appointed a DPO
report.reason: The policy provides contact details for the Data Protection Officer.

report.requirement: The personal data that is collected
report.evidence: User Data Personal data that we need to create your Spotify account
report.reason: The policy specifies the types of personal data collected.

report.requirement: The means used to collect personal data
report.evidence: We receive some of this data from you e.g. from the sign up form or account page
report.reason: The policy describes the means used to collect personal data.

report.requirement: The purpose of collecting and processing personal data
report.evidence: Our purpose for using your personal data
report.reason: The policy outlines the purposes for collecting and processing personal data.

report.requirement: The legal basis for collecting personal data (e.g. consent, contract, legal obligation)
report.evidence: we comply with our legal obligations
report.reason: The policy clearly states the legal basis for processing personal data.

report.requirement: Which personal data is mandatory and which is optional
report.evidence: the type of data collected and used depends on the type of Service Option you have
report.reason: The policy specifies which personal data is mandatory and optional.

report.requirement: The consequences of not providing personal data
report.evidence: you can request that we delete certain of your personal data
report.reason: The policy mentions consequences but does not detail all implications of not providing data.

report.requirement: The parties personal data is disclosed or shared with, and their capacity
report.evidence: we will only disclose the following personal data with those outlined in the table below
report.reason: The policy clearly states the parties with whom personal data is shared.

report.requirement: Whether personal data is transferred, disclosed or processed outside the Kingdom
report.reason: The policy explicitly mentions the transfer of personal data outside the Kingdom.

report.requirement: How long personal data is kept, or the criteria used to decide
report.evidence: We keep your personal data only as long as necessary to provide you with the Spotify Service and for Spotify’s legitimate and essential business purposes
report.reason: The policy clearly states how long personal data is kept.

report.requirement: How personal data is stored and destroyed
report.evidence: we have set certain retention periods so that data expires after a specific period of time
report.reason: The policy mentions data retention but does not specify how personal data is destroyed.

report.requirement: The data subject's rights: to be informed, access, obtain a copy, correct, and request destruction
report.evidence: It’s your right to... Be informed
report.reason: The policy clearly outlines the data subject's rights.

report.requirement: How the data subject can exercise their rights
report.evidence: You can also watch our video about Your Privacy Controls.
report.reason: The policy explains how the data subject can exercise their rights.

report.evidence: To withdraw your consent, you can: • adjust the relevant control on Spotify
report.reason: The policy clearly states how to withdraw consent.

report.requirement: The measures taken to protect personal data
report.condition: Large-scale or continuous processing, monitoring, new technologies, or automated decisions
report.evidence: we put in place appropriate technical and organizational measures to help protect the security of your personal data
report.reason: The policy clearly states the measures taken to protect personal data.

report.requirement: Whether decisions are made solely by automated processing
report.condition: Large-scale or continuous processing, monitoring, new technologies, or automated decisions
report.evidence: Spotify does not carry out this type of automated decision making in the Spotify Service
report.reason: The policy explicitly states that decisions are not made solely by automated processing.
